evidence: Extensively modifies the libmultiprocess subtree and Cap'n Proto machinery to implement native request cancellation across IPC.
rationale: The PR adds native Cap'n Proto request cancellation support to libmultiprocess, replacing out-of-band interrupt calls. As ryanofsky notes, this allows clients to cancel in-flight blocking requests natively and efficiently rather than issuing separate IPC calls, providing a durable capability to IPC clients and servers.
